name: Data Access Security Data Owner Election Review Task
description: Sent to a resource's reviewers when voting on it closes, for data owner elections configured to require manual review and to send invitations.
subject: Action required: Review a data owner election
body:
Data owner election review

Hi $__recipient.name,

As part of our efforts to improve our organization's data security posture and the governance of sensitive data access, we have initiated a campaign to identify owners for sensitive data assets.

The data owner election process has been completed and requires your approval to finalize.

What you need to do

  • Review the completed data owner election.
  • Approve the results to finalize the process in Data Access Security.

Use this link to view your data ownership election review tasks in Data Access Security: View Data Ownership Election Tasks

Thank you for supporting data ownership governance with Data Access Security.
